description: [Residential] Traffic used per hour or per day (UTC), including empty periods. Exact bytes and readable B/KB/MB/GB amounts avoid rounding small usage to zero. usage_synced_at and usage_stale describe freshness; recent requests may appear after the next sync.

granularity.description: hour or day. Defaults to day.

periods.description: How many periods back, including the current one. Up to 168 hours or 90 days. Defaults to 24 hours or 30 days.

name: residential_get_usage
title: Get Usage Tool
